title: You'll Never Guess How Profitable this Seasonal Business Is...
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
description:
UPDATE: https://youtu.be/I0rAGz60fAQ

Porch Pumpkins are taking the internet by storm...but is this business actually profitable? I think you'll be very surprised...

I sat down with Heather Torres, the rockstar ball of energy founder of Porch Pumpkins, who literally invented this whole industry! In this episode, we talk about how she turned decorating porches with pumpkins into a thriving business. We cover everything from her profit margins and gross revenue to her customer base and logistics strategy. Heather shares how she finds customers, what an average customer looks like, and how she would navigate if a recession came.
